title: Block LMS Filter
text: Compute output, error, and weights using LMS adaptive algorithm, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Enable Reset port; {Filter length} sets the length of FIR filter coefficients vector, {Block size} sets the number of samples acquired before weight, {Specify step size via} sets the source of adaptation step, {Step size (mu)} sets the adaptation step size, {Leakage factor (0 to 1)} sets the leakage factor used in leaky LMS algorithm, {Initial value of filter weights}, {Adapt port} and {Output filter weights}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Adapt
ports.summary: Option to update filter weights scalar

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: Difference between output and desired signal scalar | column vector

ports.name: Wts
ports.summary: Adaptive filter weights scalar | column vector

params.name: Filter length
params.values: Length of FIR filter coefficients vector 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Block size
params.values: Number of samples acquired before weight adaptation 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify step size via
params.values: Source of adaptation step size Dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Leakage factor (0 to 1)
params.values: Leakage factor used in leaky LMS algorithm 1.0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Initial value of filter weights
params.values: Initial value of filter weights 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Enable Reset port None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample
